targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL 5 minute) AS time, sum(input_tokens) AS input, sum(output_tokens) AS output, sum(cache_read_tokens) AS cache_read, sum(cache_creation_tokens) AS cache_write FROM claude.requests WHERE ts >= $__fromTime AND ts <= $__toTime GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT model, sum(input_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens) AS total_input FROM claude.requests WHERE ts >= $__fromTime AND ts <= $__toTime GROUP BY model ORDER BY total_input DESC
SELECT toStartOfMinute(ts) AS time, count() AS requests FROM claude.requests WHERE ts >= $__fromTime AND ts <= $__toTime GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT count() AS requests, sum(input_tokens) AS input, sum(output_tokens) AS output, sum(cache_read_tokens) AS cache_read, round(sum(cost_usd), 4) AS est_cost_usd FROM claude.requests WHERE ts >= $__fromTime AND ts <= $__toTime

SELECT session_id, any(app) AS app, any(account_id) AS account, min(ts) AS started, max(ts) AS last_seen, count() AS requests, sum(input_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens) AS input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) AS output_tokens, round(sum(cost_usd), 4) AS est_cost_usd, countIf(retry_count > 0) AS retried_requests FROM claude.requests WHERE ts >= $__fromTime AND ts <= $__toTime AND session_id != '' GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 50
